messages:
sophie (partnerships): Heads-up: product wants a safer path for shipping breaking response changes for marketplace adapters. thinking a feature-flagged negotiation + a certification smoke is best. want quick thumbs.

dan (eng-platform): Agreed. propose: gateway accepts `X-Adapter-Compat` header; if absent we enter 'compat-safe-mode' that strips unknown fields. This avoids runtime errors for older SDKs.

rachel (eng-sdks): SDK teams can add a small helper: `AdapterCompat.enable({mode: 'opt-in' | 'force'})`. We'll ship a compatibility shim package so partners don't need to bump major versions.

peter (partner-eng): Partners will ask about telemetry and audits. also need a deterministic way to prove they passed certs. Can we publish an attest artifact from CI?

hannah (product): Yes — product wants a public cert badge for listings. success criteria: handshake + smoke tests green for 7 consecutive runs. badge flips to warning if failures appear.

mike (legal): Note: any header-driven behavior must be documented in partner T&Cs. if we change semantics we need 60 days notice. i'll prepare the language.

dan (eng-platform): Technical sketch:
```
1) Adapter adds header: `X-Adapter-Compat: v1`
2) Gateway routes; if header absent -> safe-mode stripping unknown response paths
3) CI route: POST /cert-smoke -> run schema validation, latency < 400ms, no PII in `metadata`
```
We can toggle enforcement via feature flag per-listing.

rachel (eng-sdks): We'll include a local verifier and a docker harness. verifier checks: schema, latency, negative cases (missing fields). Also add a small linter for manifest contents to avoid freeform flags.

peter (partner-eng): I'll send a partner preview with the harness and an onboarding checklist. asking for a 4-week preview window.

hannah (product): Timeline suggestion: preview 4w, soft-warning 10w, requirement for new listings 20w, legacy listings 28w with opt-out petition. Product will wire badge once CI artifact format is finalized.

mike (legal): I'll draft the notice and opt-out flow. partners requesting longer runway should include justification; we'll handle case-by-case.

deploy-bot: New pipeline created: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/adapter-compat-35432 (nightly runs). Artifacts -> /artifacts/adapter-compat/35432.

sophie (partnerships): Checklist:
- publish partner preview + harness (peter)
- SDK shim + verifier (rachel)
- gateway header + feature-flag (dan)
- legal notice + opt-out (mike)
- product badge wiring (hannah)

sophie (partnerships): I'll assemble announcement tomorrow EOD. flag blockers here or DM. :sparkles:
